newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong govt paper yields down, tracing U.S..
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong govt paper yields down, tracing U.S..

text.p: Hong Kong government paper yields drifted lower on Wednesday following overnight falls in U.S. Treasury yields, dealers said.
Yields of seven-year Exchange Fund notes eased to 7.47 percent at midday from Tuesday's 7.54.
Five-year notes yielded 7.13 percent versus 7.21, and three-year notes 6.49 percent versus 6.58.
Yields of one-week Exchange Fund bills sagged to 4.95 percent from 5.07.
With buying from big investors, local paper yields fell more than their U.S. counterparts did, a European bank dealer noted.
